newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli firm in talks to develop Congo oil field.
newsitem.headline: Israeli firm in talks to develop Congo oil field.

text.p: Nafta Israel Petroleum Corp said on Tuesday it had been invited by the government of Congo to discuss development of an offshore oil field together with an unnamed foreign company.

In an announcement to the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange, Nafta said it would begin negotiations for developing the Tilapia field in the Marine 3 area off the shore of West Africa. Nafta was chosen to enter the negotiations by tender.
Nafta, an oil-exploration concern, noted that the invitation to the talks did not constitute any assurance that they would lead to a contract.
